seoTitle: Ginny & Georgia Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Ginny & Georgia test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Georgia, Ginny, Marcus, Max, Abby, Paul or Joe — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the fierce mama with a secret, the guarded poet, or the drama queen? Answer 12 everyday questions about family, friendship and secrets, and find out which Ginny & Georgia character you are.

characters.name: Georgia Miller
characters.title: The Fierce Mama
characters.summary: Charming, resourceful and fiercely protective. There's nothing you wouldn't do for your kids. Nothing.
description: Like Georgia, you're a survivor. She had her first child as a teenager and has fought for everything she's got ever since.
You can charm anyone. Georgia is free-spirited and resourceful, and she can talk her way into, or out of, almost anything.
You keep your secrets close. Georgia is very protective of her children, and her past hides more than anyone in town suspects.
characters.flaw: You'd bend any rule, or break it, to protect the people you love.
characters.signature: A big smile, a bigger secret and a plan for every emergency.
characters.clashReason: they'd lie to your face and call it protecting you

characters.name: Ginny Miller
characters.title: The Guarded Poet
characters.summary: Smart, guarded and figuring it all out. You feel everything deeply, and you're still working out where you fit.
description: Like Ginny, you're always a little bit on the outside. She's Georgia's teenage daughter, and she's struggled to fit in everywhere they've moved.
You put your feelings into words. Ginny copes by writing poetry.
You and your family are complicated. Ginny loves her mum fiercely, and fights with her just as fiercely.
characters.flaw: You get defensive the moment anyone gets too close.
characters.signature: A notebook of poems, a guarded look and a mum who drives you up the wall.
characters.clashReason: they'd shut you out the moment you said the wrong thing

characters.name: Marcus Baker
characters.title: The Quiet Artist
characters.summary: Quiet, deep and more caring than you let on. You don't say much, but you notice everything.
description: Like Marcus, you keep to yourself. He's the talented, introverted artist who lives next door to the Millers.
You've been through a lot. Marcus struggles with depression after the death of his best friend.
You care, even when it's hard to show. Marcus becomes Ginny's love interest, and one of the people who understands her best.
characters.flaw: You pull away from people when they need you most.
characters.signature: A sketchbook, a hoodie and a window that faces the house next door.
characters.clashReason: they'd disappear for days without telling you why

characters.name: Max Baker
characters.title: The Drama Queen
characters.summary: Loud, loving and gloriously dramatic. You feel everything at full volume, and you want everyone to know it.
description: Like Max, you're the life of the group. She's Marcus's twin sister and one of Ginny's closest friends.
You love your friends fiercely. Max is warm and caring, and she's at the heart of the MANG friend group.
But you can blow up. When Max is hurt, she can lash out at the people she loves most.
characters.flaw: You overreact first and apologise later.
characters.signature: A dramatic entrance, a group chat on fire and a heart on your sleeve.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn your problem into their drama

characters.name: Abby Littman
characters.title: The Sarcastic One
characters.summary: Sharp, funny and quietly struggling. You hide behind jokes, so nobody gets too close.
description: Like Abby, you've always got a sarcastic comment ready. She's one of the MANG friend group.
You're more vulnerable than you let on. Abby is insecure about her body, and she's dealing with her parents' divorce.
You hide it with humour. Abby's jokes are her armour, and sometimes they cut deeper than she means them to.
characters.flaw: You make a joke of everything, especially the things that hurt.
characters.signature: An eye roll, a sarcastic comment and a lot you're not saying.
characters.clashReason: they'd make a joke out of something that really matters to you

characters.name: Paul Randolph
characters.title: The Good Guy
characters.summary: Earnest, principled and steady. You believe in doing things properly, and doing the right thing.
description: Like Paul, you're the dependable one. He's the mayor of Wellsbury and the town's most eligible bachelor.
You believe in the rules. Paul is a by-the-book politician who wants to do right by his town.
You fall hard. Paul falls for Georgia, marries her, and builds a close bond with her son, Austin.
characters.flaw: You trust that everyone plays by the rules, even when they clearly don't.
characters.signature: A perfect suit, a campaign smile and a very honest heart.
characters.clashReason: they'd follow every rule, even the pointless ones

characters.name: Joe
characters.title: The Steady Heart
characters.summary: Kind, patient and quietly loyal. You don't make a fuss, you just show up for people.
description: Like Joe, you're the calm in the storm. He owns the Blue Farm Café in Wellsbury.
You're kind and generous. Joe gives Ginny a job, and he's always there when the Millers need him.
You know people's pasts, and you keep them to yourself. Joe knew Georgia when they were teenagers.
characters.flaw: You keep your own feelings so quiet that you miss your chance to say them.
characters.signature: A coffee machine, a calm voice and a door that's always open.
characters.clashReason: they'd stay calm and quiet when you wanted them to fight for you

questions.text: You've just moved to a new town. You...

options.text: Charm the neighbours, and have the whole street on your side by Friday
Keep your head down and hope it's better than the last place
Make three best friends on day one
Find a quiet café and become a regular

questions.text: Someone you love asks you to stop lying to them. You...

options.text: Promise. Then do whatever it takes to protect them anyway
Point out that they're the one who started it
Mean it. Honesty is everything
Tell them the truth, even the bits that hurt

questions.text: You're having a really bad day. You...

options.text: Write it all down in a poem nobody will ever read
Disappear for a while and draw
Laugh it off in public, then go quiet when you get home
Send the group chat a full, dramatic breakdown

questions.text: Your friends are planning a night in. You...

options.text: Sort the snacks, the playlist and the drama
Bring the sarcasm and the gossip
Go, but end up having a deep chat with one person all night
Offer to cook for everyone
Handle it yourself. They'll never bother you again
Go through the proper channels and make sure they're stopped
Stand between them and your family, calmly
Face them, even though you're scared

questions.text: You're invited to a fancy fundraiser. You...

options.text: Work the room and leave with three useful new friends
Give a speech. You've been practising
Stand by the snacks and make fun of everyone's outfits
Not going. Absolutely not

questions.text: A friend is upset with you, and you're not sure why. You...

options.text: Panic and send fifteen messages
Wait until they're ready to talk
Get defensive, then apologise later
Bring them a coffee and listen

questions.text: There's something in your past you'd rather nobody knew. You...

options.text: Bury it so deep nobody will ever find it
Keep it quietly, the same way you keep other people's secrets
Make a joke about it before anyone else can
Come clean. Secrets always come out

questions.text: Your crush is dating someone else. You...

options.text: Announce you're over it, then bring it up every five minutes
Pretend you don't care, very unconvincingly
Say nothing, and quietly hope
Roll your eyes and say they've got terrible taste
Come up with a creative scheme. Questions can come later
Pick up extra shifts
Make a budget and stick to it
Sell tickets to a show you haven't written yet

questions.text: You became a parent at fifteen, and you've had to fight for everything since. You...

options.text: Never let anyone see you sweat. Smile, and keep going
Accept every bit of help offered, and pay it back one day
Build a steady, stable life, and never look back
Act like you don't care what anyone thinks, even though you do

questions.text: Your mum is keeping something big from you, and you're starting to suspect what it is. You...

options.text: Investigate, then confront her
Talk it through with someone you trust
Tell absolutely everyone your theory
Ask her directly, calmly, and trust her answer
